purpose: Define desired amount, count, unit, package and tolerance semantics explicitly so shopping quantities are machine-readable without guessing from free text.

owns: Shopping Quantity and Unit Semantics semantics

topics.name: Shopping Quantity and Unit Semantics
topics.purpose: Define desired amount, count, unit, package and tolerance semantics explicitly so shopping quantities are machine-readable without guessing from free text.

semantics.quantity_rule: Desired quantity is a typed numeric/value field where applicable.
semantics.unit_rule: Unit identity/profile is explicit when quantity is dimensional.
semantics.count_rule: Discrete count and dimensional quantity remain distinct.
semantics.package_rule: Desired amount and merchant package size are separate values.
semantics.tolerance_rule: Minimum/maximum/approximate tolerance is explicit when used.
semantics.conversion_rule: Unit conversion uses declared compatible units/profile and never changes the underlying desired quantity semantics silently.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown/unspecified quantity remains explicit rather than guessed.

invariants.rule: Shopping-list data expresses planning intent only; list/item existence, ranking, recommendation or selection never authorizes purchase, payment or external order execution.

hard_gates.condition: quantity parsed only from free-text label

references.purpose: Quantity belongs to exact shopping item.

prose.summary: Define desired amount, count, unit, package and tolerance semantics explicitly so shopping quantities are machine-readable without guessing from free text.
